title: Patch: Extended art, Pixel and Comic card versions
notes: Part 3 of #2725's ten new card versions (tracker #2729): three Epic versions that restyle the card's own art, each per card, granted to no account, and offered on a seeded share of cards of its own (R2942000). Extended art (156 cards: Spells and Field Spells and Legendary and Mythic cards) runs the card's own picture past its window across the face, behind a translucent frame and rules box; Pixel (95 cards: Rare and Epic Units and Traps and Legendary and Mythic cards) draws the picture as 8-bit pixel art in a retro slate frame, its name in a pixel face; Comic (138 cards: Rare and Epic Units, Spells and Traps and Legendary and Mythic cards) draws it as pop art, flat colour, halftone dots and ink outlines, its name in a cyan burst (R2942001). Animated, a foil, a finish and a border layer on each; Signature on none, by R2949000's rule (R2942002). A Radiant face keeps every Radiant mark, and no new colour is gold (R2725004). How cards look only: nothing plays differently.

player.title: Extended art, Pixel and Comic
new: Extended art: the card's own art spills past its window across the whole card, behind a see-through frame and rules box, offered on many Spells and Legendary and Mythic cards.
Pixel: the card's art as 8-bit pixel art in a retro frame, its name in pixel letters, offered on some Rare and Epic Units and Traps and Legendary and Mythic cards.
Comic: the card's art as pop art, with flat bright colour, halftone dots and heavy ink outlines, its name in a burst, offered on some Rare and Epic cards and Legendary and Mythic cards.
changes: Each new version goes to its own mix of cards, so cards differ in what they can wear. Animated, foils, finishes and borders work on all three; Signature stays on Full art with Animated.
